AppointmentAssignment

BookingBuilder
Fluent builder for resource-booking / appointment-scheduling problems.
BookingGoal
Objective for a resource-booking problem: either maximize the number of appointments that get scheduled, or minimize the total penalty of appointments left unscheduled.
BookingGoal.MaximizeScheduledAppointments
Maximize the count of scheduled appointments (every appointment counts equally).
BookingGoal.MinimizeUnscheduledPenalty
Minimize the sum of penalty over appointments that could not be scheduled.
BookingSolution
The solved result of a resource-booking problem.
BoxConfig
Fluent configurator for a single box.
ContainerAssignment
The boxes placed into a single container in a solved solution.
ContainerAssignment.BoxPlacement
The placement of a single box within a container.
ContainerConfig
Fluent configurator for a single container.
CpSatProblem<S>
A built, immutable CP-SAT problem that yields a CpSatSolver (not just a generic Solver) so that workers, seed, callbacks, and warm starts are available without a cast.
CpSatSolver<S>
Solver backed by CP-SAT.
CuttingBuilder
Fluent builder for cutting-stock problems (1D, or 2D free or guillotine).
CuttingGoal
Minimization objective for a cutting-stock problem.
CuttingGoal.MinimizeStockUsed
Minimize the number of stock rolls used.
CuttingGoal.MinimizeTotalCost
Minimize the sum of StockConfig.cost() over all used rolls.
CuttingGoal.MinimizeWaste
Minimize the total trim waste (equivalently, total length of stock consumed).
CuttingSolution
The solved result of a cutting-stock problem (1D, or 2D free or guillotine).
DistanceSource
Source for inter-node distances (in meters) and, optionally, travel times (in minutes).
DistanceSource.Haversine
Great-circle distance computed on the fly from latitude/longitude coordinates.
DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrices
User-supplied distance and travel-time matrices with the same layout, for example from a road-network API.
DistanceSource.PrecomputedMatrix
User-supplied distance matrix; travel times are derived from travelSpeedKmh.
DriverBreak
A driver break placed on a solved Route.
EmployeeConfig

EmployeeRoster
The solved result of an employee scheduling problem.
Gantt
Structured Gantt chart data ready to pass to a renderer.
Goals
Factory methods for the BookingGoal objectives supported by the booking solver.
Goals
Factory for cutting-stock objectives.
Goals

Goals

Goals

Goals

Goals

ItemConfig
Fluent configurator for a single item.
JobConfig
Fluent configurator for a job, used inside the lambda passed to JobShopBuilder.job(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
JobShopBuilder
Fluent builder for job shop problems.
JobShopGoal
Objective for a job-shop problem.
JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespan
Minimize the makespan (time the last operation ends).
JobShopGoal.MinimizeMakespanAndTardiness
Minimize makespanWeight * makespan + tardinessWeight * totalWeightedTardiness.
JobShopGoal.MinimizeTardiness
Minimize the weighted sum of operation tardiness (weight * sum(jobWeight * max(0, end - due))) over operations that carry a due date.
JobShopGoal.MinimizeWeightedCompletionTime
Minimize sum(jobWeight * completionTime) over all jobs, where completion is the end of the last operation.
JobShopSchedule
The solved result of a job shop problem.
KnapsackGoal
Objective for a multiple-knapsack problem.
KnapsackGoal.MaximizeTotalProfit
Maximize the sum of ItemConfig.profit(long) over all packed items.
Metaheuristic
Local-search metaheuristic for vehicle routing.
ModelException
Thrown when a model is built inconsistently or violates a modeling rule (duplicate ids, missing required fields, conflicting options, etc.).
MultipleKnapsackBuilder
Fluent builder for multiple-knapsack problems.
MultipleKnapsackSolution
The solved result of a multiple-knapsack problem.
OperationConfig
Fluent configurator for a single job operation.
OptimizationProblem<S>
A constrained optimization problem that can be solved to produce a Solution.
Optimize
Entry point for building and solving operations-research problems with OR-Tools.
Orientation
One admissible axis-permutation of a box's (length, width, height) triple, i.e. the concrete (X, Y, Z) extents applied to a placed box after orientation is chosen by the solver.
PackingBuilder
Fluent builder for container-loading / 3D bin packing problems.
PackingGoal
Objective for a container-loading problem.
PackingGoal.MaximizeVolumeUtilization
Maximize the total packed volume of boxes across all containers.
PackingGoal.MinimizeContainersUsed
Minimize the number of containers that receive at least one box.
PackingSolution
The solved result of a container-loading / 3D bin packing problem.
PickupDeliveryPolicy
Ordering policy among pickup-and-delivery pairs carried by the same vehicle.
PieceConfig
Fluent configurator for a single demanded piece type.
ResourceConfig
Fluent configurator for a single bookable resource.
Route
The route assigned to a single vehicle in the solved plan.
RoutingBuilder
Fluent builder for vehicle routing problems.
RoutingGoal
Optimization goal for a routing problem.
RoutingGoal.MinimizeTotalCost
Minimize total distance plus the fixed cost of every vehicle that serves at least one stop.
RoutingGoal.MinimizeTotalDistance
Minimize the sum of arc costs (meters) across all vehicles.
RoutingGoal.MinimizeVehiclesUsed
Minimize the number of vehicles used, breaking ties by total distance.
RoutingPlan
The solved result of a vehicle routing problem.
RoutingProblem
A built, immutable routing problem that yields a RoutingSolver (not just a generic Solver) so that firstSolution and improveWith are available without a cast.
RoutingSolver
Routing-specific solver that adds RoutingSolver.firstSolution(io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.Strategy) and RoutingSolver.improveWith(io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.Metaheuristic) on top of the shared Solver interface.
Rule
Hard constraint applied to the scheduling model.
Rule.ForbidSequence
Forbids an employee from working a shift of toCategory on the calendar day right after a shift of fromCategory, whatever the clock times.
Rule.MaxConsecutiveNightShifts
At most maxNights night shifts in any run of maxNights + 1 consecutive calendar days per employee.
Rule.MaxConsecutiveWorkDays
Caps the number of consecutive calendar days an employee may work.
Rule.MaxShiftsPerWeek
At most maxShifts assignments in any rolling 7-day window per employee.
Rule.MinRestBetweenShifts
Minimum rest gap that must separate any two shifts worked by the same employee.
Rule.OneShiftPerEmployeePerDay
Forbids an employee from being assigned to more than one shift on any single calendar day.
Rules
Factory for hard scheduling constraints.
ScheduledOperation
A solved operation with its start and end times.
SchedulingBuilder
Fluent builder for employee scheduling problems.
SchedulingGoal
Primary minimization objective.
SchedulingGoal.MinimizeTotalLaborCost
Objective that minimizes the sum of costPerHour * scheduled hours across all assignments.
ShiftAssignment
A single employee-to-shift assignment in a solved roster.
ShiftConfig
Fluent configurator for a shift, used inside the lambda passed to SchedulingBuilder.shift(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
SoftGoal
Soft preference folded into the weighted objective.
SoftGoal.BalanceWorkloadAcrossEmployees
Penalize the spread between the most- and least-loaded employee.
SoftGoal.HonorEmployeePreferences
Reward (subtract from the objective) each satisfied employee shift preference.
SoftGoal.PenalizeContractDeviation
Penalize every minute an employee works above or below their contracted hours in a full week.
SoftGoal.PenalizeUnderstaffing
Penalize each employee missing between a shift's minimum and its target.
Solution
The result of solving an OptimizationProblem: the solver status, the objective value reached, and how long the solve took.
SolveDiagnostics
Search statistics reported alongside a Solution.
Solver<S>
Configurable solver for an OptimizationProblem, obtained via OptimizationProblem.solver().
SolveStatus
Outcome of a solve attempt, mapped from the underlying OR-Tools solver status.
StockAssignment
The pieces cut from a single stock roll/sheet in a solved solution.
StockAssignment.CutPiece
One piece cut from a roll/sheet.
StockConfig
Fluent configurator for a single stock roll type.
StopConfig
Fluent configurator for a stop, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.stop(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
Strategy
First-solution strategy for vehicle routing.
TimeSlot
A half-open time window [start, end) on the absolute time-line.
VehicleConfig
Fluent configurator for a vehicle, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.vehicle(String, java.util.function.Consumer).
Visit
One stop visit on a solved Route.
